algebra_scope: Exact aggregate identities; no new extracted columns, models, labels or trigger features. Jointly sufficient primitives are permitted; full-family trigger as a feature remains prohibited.

A1.detail: Growth, D, new count/share and historical missing marker expose all A1 components. Perfect observed recall and high growth importance are consistent with alignment, not private intent leakage by themselves.

A2.classification: Genuine omitted information plus model-specific weakness
A2.detail: Top2 share, change and historical marker present; absolute recent service count>=8 not supplied. Both detected/missed positives have large change, so a near-change-threshold explanation is unsupported.

A3.detail: Recent breadth and acceleration/history marker present. Absolute count is not explicit; acceleration equals count when the denominator floor is active, but baseline count is not supplied to establish that identity universally.

A4.classification: Arithmetic ingredients supplied; learning/support issue remains
A4.detail: Cash counts, values, distinct wallets, signed historical change and current type permit count/value skew, agreement and eligibility checks. The frozen fields support the compound rule in principle; HGB rescues 46/71 XGB Validation misses without feature changes. This cannot prove a universal algorithm advantage or identify an exact fitting cause.

N1.detail: Directed count, breadth and acceleration/historical marker present; recent incoming total value absent. Current amount alone is not the historical sum.

N2.detail: Directed count, breadth and acceleration/historical marker present; recent outgoing total value absent.

N3.detail: All-path count and minimum length do not expose all monetary routes. Seven Validation positives have selected summaries incompatible with amount bounds; four are missed. This co-occurrence is not causal attribution of four misses.

N4.detail: Let q=(Oprior+a)/F and r=F-Oprior. F=(a-r)/(q-1) when q!=1; when q=1, a=r and F remains unidentified by these quantities. Thus the F>=10000 gate is not guaranteed recoverable from the N4 fields. No numerical reconstruction is substituted into X.

S1.detail: Although distinct amount count is absent, variation>=2 is equivalent to n*max_share>1 for positive amounts (exact-aggregate algebra). Thus its binary variation gate is recoverable from count and max share; do not call the omitted count an irreducible gap. Float64 precision remains the saved contract.

S2.classification: Genuine omitted information and sparse support
S2.detail: Recent cluster count/share/current amount present. Exact cluster sum, baseline similar count/rate and exact S2 historical support are not generally recoverable. Current amount times count approximates but does not equal the sum under 5% tolerance. Coverage 35 alone cannot encode baseline event support.

S3.detail: Day count/hour breadth and historical daily growth present; current-day total value is not generally recoverable from the one-hour sum.

S4.classification: Genuine omissions plus recoverable cross-field quantities
S4.detail: Current band and band count present. n(R7d)=S2 similar-count/similar-share because current always belongs to its own cluster; band share follows by dividing band count by that n. These are not necessarily missing information. Band amount variation, baseline band frequency and exact S4 baseline support remain absent.

stage20_review.S1: Do not add distinct-count for binary variation: exact aggregates n*max_share>1 express variation; test numeric sensitivity, no new column.
stage20_review.S2_rates: n(C_B)/4 and recent_count/max(1,n(C_B)/4) recoverable once baseline count exists; do not add either separately.
stage20_review.S4: n_R=similar_count/similar_share (current ensures positive denominator); band share=band_count/n_R. Algebraic recoverability is not a promise a tree learns division.
stage20_review.S4_rates: baseline band count/4 and band-growth ratio recoverable once count exists; no separate transform.
stage20_review.precision: Algebra at exact aggregates may suffer float rounding; future fixtures required. No saved column was reconstructed.
stage20_review.support: Exact baseline activity count beyond the >=4 gate deferred. Two baseline missing markers already communicate historical availability, consistent with existing marker policy; no standalone eligibility flag.

status: Static review plus saved-data observations; no amendment applied
uncertainty: Absence of a named field need not imply information loss. Conversely high observed accuracy is not proof that the representation is sufficient for all permitted histories.
